en: The image shows an old black-and-white postcard featuring a statue of a lion on a large stone pedestal, surrounded by trees and what appears to be a public square or park area. In the background, there are residential or public buildings with gabled roofs. The text at the top reads 'Bad Harzburg. Kriegerdenkmal.' in German, and there is a publisher's imprint at the bottom: 'Brück & Sohn, Meißen.'
